blocks.tamil_translation: he would not give it to him; if he asks for a silver coin, he would not give that either; if he asks for a single paisa, he would not give even one paisa. (Yet his standing with Allah Ta'ala is such that) if he asks Allah Ta'ala for Jannah, Allah Ta'ala will give him Jannah. (On that man's body there will be only) two old sheets, and nobody pays him the slightest attention. (Yet) if he swears an oath by Allah (with the strength of heart that entrusts his affairs to) Allah Ta'ala, Allah Ta'ala will certainly fulfil his oath” — Hazrat Thawban (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.
Lower your wing (of humility) for the believers!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَسَارِعُوْا اِلَي مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَاْلاَرْضُ لا اُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۞ الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُوْنَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَالْكَاظِمِيْنَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِيْنَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ؕ وَاللهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: And hasten towards forgiveness from your Rabb and towards a Jannah whose breadth is the heavens and the earth; it has been prepared for those who fear (Allah)..
